internal_candidates.reason: Adds a new enum value to an nmcli-internal typedef enum in src/nmcli/utils.h. This header is not part of the public libnm API (it is in src/nmcli/, not in src/libnm/ or include/). The enum value is used internally by nmcli's metagen display system. The _NUM sentinel value shifts by 1, but since this only affects nmcli's own array sizing and the array already uses _NUM for its declared dimension, this is a self-contained internal change with no external ABI impact.

summary: 0 compatibility findings in this shard. All changes are internal to nmcli's header and have no external API/ABI impact.
